content: समाधिः .²1 Collecting, composing, concentrating (as mind). .²2 Profound or abstract meditation, concentration of mind on one object, perfect absorption of thought into the one object of meditation, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the Supreme Spirit, (the 8th and last stage of Yoga); व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिः समाधौ न विधीयते <ls>Bg. 2. 44</ls>; आत्मेश्वराणां न हि जातु विघ्नाः समाधिभेदप्रभवो भवन्ति <ls>Ku. 3. 40</ls>, <ls n="Ku. 3.">50</ls>; <ls>Mk. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Bh. 3. 54</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 79</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 55</ls>. .²3 Intentness, concentration (in general), fixing of thoughts; यथा भानुगतं तेजो मणिः शुद्धः समाधिना . आदत्ते राजशार्दूल तथा योगः प्रवर्तते .. <ls>Mb. 12. 298. 12</ls>; तस्यां लग्नसमाधि (मानसम्) <ls>Gīt. 3</ls>; अहःसु तस्या हृदि ये समाधयः <ls>Rām. Ch. 2. 41</ls>. .²4 Penance, religious obligation, devotion (to penance); अस्त्येतदन्यसमाधिभीरुत्वं देवानाम् <ls>Ś. 1</ls>; तपःसमाधि <ls>Ku. 3. 24</ls>; अथोपयन्तारमलं समाधिना <ls n="Ku.">5. 24</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 6</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">1. 59</ls>; सर्वथा दृढसमाधिर्भव <ls>Nāg. 5</ls>. .²5 Bringing together, concentration, combination, collection; union, a set; सा तस्य धर्मार्थसमाधियुक्तं निशम्य वाक्यम् <ls>Rām. 4. 33. 50</ls>; तं वेधा विदधे नूनं महाभूतसमाधिना <ls>R. 1. 29</ls>. .²6 Reconciliation, settling or composing differences. .²7 Silence. .²8 Agreement, assent, promise. .²9 Requital. .²10 Completion, accomplishment. .²11 Perseverance in extreme difficulties. .²12 Attempting impossibilities. .²13 Laying up corn (in times of famine), storing grain. .²14 A tomb. .²15 The joint of the neck; a particular position of the neck; अंसाववष्टब्धनतौ समाधिः <ls>Ki. 16. 21</ls>. .²16 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A figure of speech thus defined by Mammaṭa; समाधिः सुकरं कार्यं कारणान्तरयोगतः <ls>K. P. 10</ls>; see <ls>S. D. 614</ls>. .²17 One of the ten Guṇas or merits of style; अन्यधर्मस्ततोऽन्यत्र लोकसीमानुरोधिना . सम्यगाधीयते यत्र स समाधिः स्मृतो यथा .. <ls>Kāv. 1. 93</ls>. .²18 A religious vow or self-imposed restraint. .²19 Support, upholding.
